column1: # LCDwiki ES3C28P (ESP32-S3 N16R8) has 16MB flash. Layout:
#   factory app    4M    — single-app slot for v1 (no OTA yet)
#   storage        ~12M  — LittleFS for the temperature reading log
# The reading log is the one partition that meaningfully grows: 16 B/record at
# one record a minute is ~23 KB/day. storage/ caps and rotates it well below this
# size (see storage.hpp) — the headroom is for future use
